description: Source code for a CWMP plugin handling XMPP connections, including subscription management, connection updates, and initialization routines.

methods.name: is_current_cnx
methods.description: Checks if the given connection string matches the current XMPP connection.

methods.name: set_connreq_jabber_id
methods.description: Sets the ConnReqJabberID attribute in the management server.

methods.name: update_connreq_jabber_id
methods.description: Updates the Jabber ID based on the current connection status.

methods.name: xmpp_connection_deleted_cb
methods.description: Callback for handling deletion of an XMPP connection.

methods.name: xmpp_connection_updated_cb
methods.description: Callback for handling updates to an XMPP connection.

methods.name: xmpp_connection_add_sub
methods.description: Subscribes to changes in a specific XMPP connection.

methods.name: xmpp_connection_del_sub
methods.description: Unsubscribes from changes in a specific XMPP connection.

methods.name: _connreq_xmpp_connection_changed
methods.description: Handles changes in the XMPP connection request parameter.

methods.name: deferred_init_timer_cb
methods.description: Timer callback to initialize XMPP connection subscriptions.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_xmpp_init
methods.description: Initializes the XMPP plugin, setting up timers and subscriptions.
